# RN-4 (KOBE-748): environment variables KAIJU_* (spec §3 changes 5, §4 step 4). The script
# renames the names; by hand: one shared readEnv helper that falls back to KOBE_* for one release
# and logs one warning naming the variables to rename, in each service's config.ts; chart
# templates and values; operator docs. RN-10 removes the fallback.
#
# Same format as allowlist.txt (scripts/rename/README.md). The script changes an occurrence only
# where a pattern below matches it AND the allowlist gives it to this step AND no permanent entry
# covers it. Generated files and the allowlist's "Triage:" groups are left out on purpose: the
# dry run lists them as left for hand edits until this step's ticket narrows them into patterns.

== RN-4: Environment variables (KAIJU_* with a one-release KOBE_* fallback)
** /\bKOBE_(?!(?:WRITES_PER_HOUR_KEY|WRITES_PER_HOUR_DEFAULT|TOOLS_TIMEOUT_MS|TOOL|TEAM_SAMPLES|SKILL_NAMES_ADDED_LATER|SKILL_NAMES|SKILL_IDS|SITE_TOOLS|SITE_SAMPLES|SEED_RETRY|SECTIONS|RESULT_MAX_BYTES|READS_PER_MINUTE_KEY|READS_PER_MINUTE_DEFAULT|PROVIDER_ID|PROVIDER|PAGE_MAX|PACKAGES_DIR|MODEL_ERROR_PREFIX|MEMORY_ITEM_TOOLS|MCP_TEAM_SETTING|MCP_TEAM_LEVELS|MCP_TEAM_LEVEL_DEFAULT|MCP_MODES|MCP_MODE_LABELS|MCP_MODE_KEY|MCP_MODE_DEFAULT|MCP_HINTS|LIMITS|LIMIT_MIN|LIMIT_MAX|LEVEL_LABELS|GALLERY_KEY|FILE|EVENT_TYPES|EVENT_DROPPED_TYPE|ENDPOINTS|DOCS_TOOLS|DIR|BUILTIN_NAMES|BUILTIN_CONNECTOR_URL|BUILTIN_CONNECTOR_ID|AGENT_KEY|ADMIN_WRITE_REASON|ADMIN_TOOLS|ADMIN_TEXT|ADMIN_SUMMARY_MAX|ADMIN_RESULT_HIDDEN|ADMIN_NOT_REMEMBERED|ADMIN_NOT_ALLOWED_REASON)\b)[A-Z0-9_]*/
